text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios faints from overexertion. She is built to run miles, so training for medium-distance races places a great burden on her body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite that, Daitaku Helios staunchly swears to run the autumn Tenno Sho to see her bestie's triumphant victory from right beside her.
